info.title: Leetspeak Translator
info.description: Takes a piece of text and either turns it into leetspeak (swapping some letters for numbers and symbols, like 'hello' becoming 'h3110') or turns leetspeak back into normal, easy-to-read words. The same words always produce the same result, so answers never change unexpectedly.
info.x-guidance: Send the text to convert, pick a direction ('to_leet' or 'to_normal'), and optionally a level ('basic', 'intermediate', 'advanced') for how heavily to substitute characters when converting to leetspeak. The result is always the same for the same input, so it can be cached or reused safely.
info.x-ai-instructions: Send the text to convert, pick a direction ('to_leet' or 'to_normal'), and optionally a level ('basic', 'intermediate', 'advanced') for how heavily to substitute characters when converting to leetspeak. The result is always the same for the same input, so it can be cached or reused safely.
info.x-provider: _done — single-purpose utility APIs for developers and AI agents. Pay per call with USDC on Base Mainnet or Solana Mainnet.
